description: Open a simulated position at the live price. Simulated money only - no real funds are ever at risk. Requires an API key.

client_order_id.description: Your own id - retrying with the same one returns the first position instead of opening a second

dry_run.description: true = validate and price the trade (entry, liquidation, quantity, fees) and write NOTHING

leverage.description: 1 to the symbol cap from get_markets

trail_pct.description: Trailing stop distance in percent (0.05-50): the stop follows the best price seen, server-side, even while the bot is offline

name: paper_open
title: Open a paper position
